company.name: WestBridge IT Solutions
company.tagline: Web design & development agency in Surrey, BC, Canada

chunks.text: WestBridge IT Solutions — Web design & development agency in Surrey, BC, Canada. Email: support@westbridgeitsolutions.com. Phone: +1-604-365-7605. Location: Surrey, British Columbia, Canada.
Process: discovery call → strategy & wireframes → design → development → launch → ongoing support. Collaborative and transparent at every stage.
Service — Crafted Websites: High-performance sites with React, Next.js, responsive design, SEO.
Service — Website Redesign: Modern facelifts, UI/UX audits, conversion-focused redesigns.
Service — eCommerce Solutions: Shopify, secure payments, inventory sync, conversion-focused stores.
Service — CMS & Dynamic Sites: Headless CMS, custom dashboards, scalable content systems.
Service — Landing Pages: Conversion-centered landing pages, A/B testing, fast load times.
Service — Consistent Identity: Style guides, design systems, logos, cohesive brand language.
Service — Motion Design: Lottie, GSAP, micro-interactions, engaging animations.
Service — UX Strategy: User testing, wireframing, journey mapping, data-driven planning.
Service — Performance: Core Web Vitals, code splitting, CDN, technical SEO optimization.
Service — Ongoing Support: Security patches, content updates, proactive monitoring after launch.
FAQ: how do i get started? Reach out via the contact form or WhatsApp. We schedule a discovery call, then provide a tailored proposal and roadmap.
chunks.faqAnswer: Reach out via the contact form or WhatsApp. We schedule a discovery call, then provide a tailored proposal and roadmap.

chunks.text: FAQ: how involved do i need to be? Collaborative partnership. We handle design and dev; your feedback at strategy, design approval, and final review is key.
chunks.faqKey: how involved do i need to be
chunks.faqAnswer: Collaborative partnership. We handle design and dev; your feedback at strategy, design approval, and final review is key.

chunks.text: FAQ: how long does it take to build a website? Standard corporate sites: 4–8 weeks. Complex eCommerce or custom apps: 10–16 weeks. Timeline depends on scope.
chunks.faqKey: how long does it take to build a website
chunks.faqAnswer: Standard corporate sites: 4–8 weeks. Complex eCommerce or custom apps: 10–16 weeks. Timeline depends on scope.

chunks.text: FAQ: do you provide support after launch? Yes. We offer maintenance and support packages for security, updates, and performance.
chunks.faqKey: do you provide support after launch
chunks.faqAnswer: Yes. We offer maintenance and support packages for security, updates, and performance.
